items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: He called a fella by the name of Mexic, who was still alive and in our union. Joe Mexic.

ctx.x: I still got the picture of it. So we go up to somewhere, by the school, by the library up there. And we get a little girl and dress her up in like a little pirate's costume with a bandana around her head like this. And we're both standing there. And I got a shovel, and Charlie's there pointing at it. And we're planting that Jean Lafitte rose in the ground. And that's what got in the newspaper. We got it in the newspaper and we had it all over town. The Jean Lafitte Rose. When the British are coming, it turns red.…
